title: Rome Client
description: A Fabric client mod for the Rome server — adds an emoji picker, chat integration, and server-synced emoji support.
body:
# Rome Client

A Fabric client mod built for the **Rome** Minecraft server.
> Note: This is for a private SMP server, althought the plugin used for it might become public later so this mod will come in handy

## Features

- **Emoji Picker** -> opens directly from the chat screen with a single click
- **Category Tabs** -> browse emojis by category
- **Search** -> filter emojis by name instantly
- **Click to Insert** -> inserts the emoji shortcode into your chat input at cursor position
- **Server-Synced** -> emoji list is automatically received from the server on join, no manual config needed
- **Resource Pack Integration** -> server pushes the emoji resource pack automatically so all glyphs render correctly

## Usage

1. Join the Rome server
2. Accept the resource pack when prompted
3. Open chat and click the emoji button (bottom right of the chat screen)
4. Browse or search for an emoji and click it to insert
